title: Stretch Bottom Edge (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Stretch Bottom Edge applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Stretch Bottom Edge (BtnStretchBottomEdge) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnStretchBottomEdge deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed StretchBottomEdge stretches every selected shape from its own bottom edge to the documented reference edge; the feature reports execution, the unselected shapes are untouched, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed StretchBottomEdge stretches every selected shape from its own bottom edge to the documented reference edge; the feature reports execution, the unselected shapes are untouched, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
